notes.Groq_API: Existing Groq key used by the Cloudflare-native Jyotish handler.
notes.nvidia_api: Existing NVIDIA NIM fallback key used by the Cloudflare-native Jyotish handler.
notes.TV_RELAY_SECRET: Existing media relay signing secret; can satisfy the media relay one-of requirement.
notes.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: Google Identity Services OAuth web client ID. Identity only; no Gmail/Drive scope.
notes.VAPID_SUBJECT: Web Push VAPID subject, normally a mailto: or https: contact URI.
notes.CRON_SECRET: Bearer secret for manual HTTP cron endpoints; scheduled() invocations do not require it.
notes.RASHIFAL_SERVICE_TOKEN: Cloudflare-native replacement for the old Rashifal service token; only its SHA-256 hash is exposed by the compatibility endpoint.
notes.ADMIN_GOOGLE_SUBJECTS: Comma-separated Google subject IDs authorized for calendar admin.
notes.ADMIN_EMAILS: Fallback comma-separated verified Google emails authorized for calendar admin.
notes.PUBLIC_SITE_URL: Final canonical production origin; preferably a non-secret Worker variable.
